[[File:SwoopRacing-TSS.jpg|thumb|XB-01 bike entered swoop races, but were often sabotage.]]
The '''XB-01 Speeder Bike''' was a remote-controlled [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] that was developed by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They entered the bike in the [[Cularin Classic]] [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop race]], in which it was to be pitted against organic racers, drawing significant media coverage to the event. During the race, the bike's controls were operated by the SoroSuub employee [[Imik Suum]]. However the [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]] criminal [[Mebara Jos]] [[Jammer/Legends|jammed]] the bike's controls, hoping to make it crash into a crowd of spectators, although the [[Heroes of Cularin]] were able to prevent the bike from leaving the course.
